title: onoclea struthiopteris f. pubescens
intro: Onoclea struthiopteris f. pubescens, commonly known as the pubescent fern or woolly polypody, is a type of fern belonging to the family Polypodiaceae. It is used in traditional medicine to promote overall health and well-being, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Onoclea struthiopteris f. pubescens include reducing inflammation, improving respiratory function, and acting as an antimicrobial agent. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other compounds with potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
